Flying saucer type vertical take-off high-speed electromagnetic airplane -China patent

#ufotwitter

Patent uses a dual-power system (generator + electromagnetic propulsion) for low fuel consumption, high thrust, high speed, low noise, large payload, and long range. Control is via computer (manual or fully autonomous/unmanned). The design aims to be simple, scientific, safe, low-cost, and practical.

⚙️ Core idea (what it claims to do)

The design combines several elements:

1. Disc-shaped (UFO-like) airframe

Circular structure for:

omnidirectional airflow
reduced drag (in theory)
stability during vertical lift

2. Electromagnetic propulsion system

The patent describes electromagnetic force generation instead of conventional engines
Likely involves:rotating electromagnetic fields
charged particles / plasma interaction
internal power supply feeding coils

3. Vertical lift mechanism

Instead of wings + thrust, it proposes:field-driven lift or thrust
possibly assisted by airflow manipulation

🚀 How it is supposed to work

Conceptually, the craft would:

Generate a strong electromagnetic field
Interact with:

ionized air (atmosphere), or internal charged particles

Produce thrust or lift without traditional propellers or jet exhaust

Transition to forward flight at high speed

Inventor & Assignee

Inventor: Xia Jianguo (夏建国)

Original Assignee: Individual (Xia Jianguo)

Later transferred (2019) to Haining Luoxi Industrial Development Co., Ltd.
